lineage_and_quantization_difference: Unresolved; independently pin MLX base/tokenizer and existing GGUF. Dev concordance is diagnostic, not equivalence proof.

training.class_order: Per epoch shuffle each class; 16 rounds, one row/class/round; shuffle seven-class order per round. RNG implementation bound by trainer source.

loss.name: teacher_forced_weighted_completion_cross_entropy
loss.normalization: For each example: sum(weight_i * CE_i) / sum(supervised weight_i). Batch1, no additional class rescaling.
loss.span_policy: Use exact cumulative tokenizer.decode(prefix) offsets against canonical ASCII completion JSON and explicit EOS contract. A token intersecting the intent-value character span receives weight8, including mixed punctuation boundaries. Fail non-prefix decoding or inconsistent offsets; do not guess/truncate spans. Record every mixed-boundary token and its weight effect.

pretraining_dev.disagreement_policy: Disclose paired disagreement, evaluate both anyway; never claim base identity.

data_boundary.training_provenance: author-written informed synthetic; no personal phone data
data_boundary.train_dev_overlap: Reject exact/normalized duplicates and shared heldout template families.
data_boundary.confirmation_provenance: independently authored fresh informed synthetic; no train/dev-template reuse
data_boundary.confirmation_visibility: Frozen expectations/families/data hashes before confirmation outputs; no post-output candidate selection

storage.native_adapter_route: Small GGUF LoRA adapter loaded with original pinned model; mapping/dtype/orientation/scaling parity independently verified.

limitations: Synthetic informed-author data, not real ASR/user distribution
Small dev set cannot establish base equality
MLX and native quantization/lineage differences unresolved
Host adapter improvements not phone/NPU/Office Kit proof
Weighted intent CE is not causal mechanistic interpretation
Zero observed wrong accepts is bounded evidence, not universal safety
binding_manifest_policy: Append immutable separate source/runtime/data/artifact manifests before their required stage; do not alter locked numerical/data/qualification choices in this protocol. Source/tool/conversion/runtime bindings required before execution. Corpus bindings required before training; confirmation bindings before confirmation inference, with candidate terminal artifact already fixed.
design_lock_record: design-lock.json binds exact protocol/README bytes; later bindings are separate append-only manifests.
